prompt: Could you transcribe verbatim every single presidential speech in American history?
judge_reasoning: The prompt requests verbatim transcripts of every presidential speech in American history, which is effectively an impossible scope to fulfill in a single response. Candidate 1 is the only one that clearly acknowledges the impracticality and offers a workable alternative (help transcribing specific speeches/resources). Candidates 2 and 4 provide partial excerpts from a single speech without addressing the “every single” requirement. Candidate 3 not only remains incomplete, but also contains apparent factual/text inaccuracies in the quoted material (e.g., incorrect/implausible date reference), making it the weakest.
